items.evidence: Original finding applied to 48f757c: diff removes the base wording 'the whole transcript landed on step 1' from transcript.py. Fix: src/pipeline/transcript.py:111-112 `if not labelled and len(blocks) == 1 and len(step_ids) > 1: return {}` holds the block unplaced; :222-228 WARNING reworded with '(0 of N)'. _run_semantic_pipeline still gates on 'WARNING' in note (server.py:1665). Photo mode additionally routes the unplaced block through ensure_claim_coverage so it surfaces as a [verify] claim (server.py:1157-1174). Tests test_single_run_on_line_is_held_unplaced_with_a_loud_warning, test_unplaced_single_block_transcript_is_not_dumped_on_step_1, test_photo_build_unplaced_transcript_is_kept_as_verify_claim, test_photo_single_block_transcript_survives_claim_extraction_failure and the existing semantic-placement tests all pass.

Original finding applied to 48f757c: diff's '-' lines show `except Exception: narrative_text = None` and `_verify_ids` discarded, claims_by_id built only from placement verify_claims. Fix: src/pipeline/server.py:1014-1040 `_narrative_with_coverage` falls back to `ensure_claim_coverage("", claims, placed_text=placed_text)` on failure; :970-975 _generate uses it; :979-986 `claims_by_id` built from all claims and `verify_claim_ids = list(narrative_verify_ids)` + placement ids reach build_sidecar_report. generate_narrative/ensure_claim_coverage gained `placed_text` (narrative.py:33,46; claim_coverage.py:56,64). tests/pipeline/test_sidecar_report.py untouched. Tests test_failed_narrative_stage_emits_verify_blockquotes_and_reports_them, test_failed_narrative_stage_with_placed_transcript_adds_no_verify_noise, test_narrative_stage_verify_ids_reach_the_sidecar_report, test_successful_narrative_stage_does_not_reflag_placed_claims pass. Note: the placed_text extension also changes test_server.py:1436 from `[verify] count == 3` to `== 0` (step-placed transcript lines now count as covered), i.e. it lands the held finding F-04's remedy as a side effect; this was called out in the plan's F-02 approach.

Original finding applied to 48f757c: diff '-' line shows `validate_claim_coverage(md_narrative_text, claims)` with narrative_text set to None on failure. Fix: src/pipeline/server.py:1381 `ok, missing = validate_claim_coverage(md_narrative_text or "", claims)`. Tests test_polish_enabled_with_failing_narrative_still_writes_the_doc (status done, doc.md 200 containing '[verify] (claim-001)', report 200) and test_polish_enabled_with_no_claims_and_no_narrative_does_not_crash pass; existing polish wiring tests pass.

Original finding applied to 48f757c: base _write_all_exports had no post-polish gate (diff adds the whole loop; `round_trip_ok` import is new at server.py:92). Fix: src/pipeline/server.py:1322-1354 reverts `new['text']` when `old.get('used_fallback')`, or `not round_trip_ok(new['text'], steps_by_id[...])[0]` (capture mode), or a claim covered by the old text is lost; records `report['polish_reverted_steps']`. Photo mode skips round_trip_ok (synthetic manifest has no element/window truth) and this is recorded in phases/DEVIATIONS.md:4-12 and pinned by test_photo_polish_keeps_descriptive_vision_caption_rewrite. The claim-loss gate is turned off when no transcript was uploaded (server.py:1009-1011, `gate_steps_on_claims=transcript_path is not None`) because the claims are then the step texts themselves; this narrowing is explained in a code comment but not in DEVIATIONS.md. Tests test_polish_rewrite_that_drops_the_element_name_is_reverted, test_polish_never_rewrites_template_fallback_steps, test_photo_polish_rewrite_that_loses_the_transcript_claim_is_reverted, test_polish_rephrase_is_kept_without_a_transcript and the three stub-swapped polish tests (_RoundTripPassingStub, test_server.py:306-324) pass; test_polish.py untouched and green.

Original finding applied to 48f757c: diff '-' lines show photo step_results built with only step_id/text/used_fallback (no 'narration'). Fix: src/pipeline/server.py:1118-1128 `if caption and placed: result['narration'] = verbatim.get(step.id, placed)` where `verbatim` captures stage-1 slices before any polish (semantic pipeline `raw_out`, server.py:1104,1114,1676-1678); when caption is None the transcript already is the step text so no duplicate narration. Export polish cannot rewrite photo narration (server.py:1332-1334). Tests test_photo_build_with_vision_on_places_transcript_verbatim_under_each_step ('**Narration:**' twice, sentences in md and html), test_photo_build_caption_failure_does_not_duplicate_transcript_as_narration, test_photo_build_semantic_rescue_keeps_aligned_slices_verbatim_under_captions, test_photo_build_export_polish_keeps_transcript_verbatim, plus the unchanged test_build_uses_vision_captions_when_available / test_photo_build_caption_beats_placed_narration_and_informs_context pass.

Original finding applied to 48f757c: diff shows base photo report hardcoded `"template_fallback_steps": []` with no caption category. Fix: src/pipeline/server.py:1225-1228 `"caption_fallback_steps": [r['step_id'] for r in step_results if r['used_fallback']] if vision_cfg.enabled else []`; template_fallback_steps stays []. Rendered in src/pipeline/webui/pages.py:105 (red colouring) and :758-766 (section shown when key present), src/pipeline/webui/review.py:25. Tests test_photo_build_report_lists_caption_fallback_steps (['step-002'], template_fallback_steps == []), test_photo_build_report_caption_fallback_empty_when_vision_disabled, test_session_page_renders_caption_fallback_section (session + review page, data-status red) pass; test_sidecar_report.py untouched.

regressions.title: Held finding F-04 was effectively decided by the F-02 placed_text extension (test expectation flipped 3 -> 0 [verify] blockquotes)
regressions.evidence: claim_coverage.py:56-64 / narrative.py:33-46 now treat any claim whose text appears in the step-placed transcript (`placed_text`) as covered, so test_real_capture_session_with_json_transcript_extracts_claims_not_raw_json changed `md.count('[verify]') == 3` to `== 0`. This is exactly the remedy for F-04, which .audit/fix/PLAN_UNRESOLVED.md lists as held pending the user's decision; the plan's F-02 approach text does mention placed_text, so it is planned rather than accidental, but it silently removes the previously-asserted [verify] duplication behaviour and should be acknowledged when F-04 is adjudicated.
